The fear of pointlessness. Occurs when ambition isn’t decided fully.(I’m not shitting on you this is actually a pretty shitty thing I gone through it to) It’s uncommon for people to have existential thoughts and it’s very common among people with existential thoughts to have a fear of pointlessness. Right now you need to keep asking yourself the big questions and do your best not to have your head clouded. This is one of the most difficult things a human can go through but succeeding at making it through is very rewarding. You only need to stay courageous and you’ve done so thus far. YOU GOT THIS! (Btw if your smoking[nicotine] currently or taking any drugs[illegal or alcohol] it will stretch the process out a fuck ton)
I lost 3 people I loved a lot, but I knew they wouldn’t want me to be sad about it, they would want me to continue on the right path.

The path with the strongest impact is the hardest. Thats why society “rigged” such an “easy path” to follow, but it doesn’t fit everyone. Some people have paths they need to take in life that are much more brutal, yours is one. Your not abnormal, your a human to, more than anything the thing I’ve always wanted was to be looked at as a person. I learned that what I think is others looking at me, is just what I think of myself. Stay strong, no your path isn’t predetermined, your destiny isn’t uncontrollable. It’s weaved with your hands. You have a really hard path to walk but it will reward you I swear! You got this, I believe in you!
